convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 'AnchoredMomentum' indicator (unknown custom indicator, not built-in) and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. The custom indicator logic and trading algorithms require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: AnchoredMomentum buffer 0
derived_values.formula: iCustom(Symbol(), H4, 'AnchoredMomentum', MomPeriod=8, SmoothPeriod=6, IPC=PRICE_CLOSE, UpLevel=0.025, DnLevel=-0.025, 0)[bar]

other_exits: Long closed when AnchoredMomentum drops below DnLevel (-0.025)
Short closed when AnchoredMomentum rises above UpLevel (+0.025)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM=-0.1 means fixed lot of 0.1 (negative value = lot size per TradeAlgorithms.mqh convention)

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses Value[1] (prior bar) vs level comparison with Value[0] (2 bars back) as confirmation. Long: Value[1] > UpLevel AND Value[0] <= UpLevel (crossover above +0.025). Short: Value[1] < DnLevel AND Value[0] <= DnLevel (crossunder below -0.025). SignalBar=1 means signals read from bar index 1 (last closed bar). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with time-gated order logic (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime). LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement AnchoredMomentum indicator: it computes a zero-lagged momentum as (SMA-applied_price - EMA_applied_price)/SMA_applied_price with periods 8 and 6 respectively. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions need manual translation - they handle position checks, lot sizing from MM parameter (negative=fixed lot), stop/take placement, and time-gated order submission to prevent duplicate orders within same bar. The entry crossover logic: long when AnchoredMomentum[bar-1] > 0.025 AND AnchoredMomentum[bar-2] <= 0.025; short when AnchoredMomentum[bar-1] < -0.025 AND AnchoredMomentum[bar-2] <= -0.025. SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points.
